messages:
taylor: Quick heads-up — partner roundtable next month. Goal: 30-min panel + 20-min live-demo block. We need: speaker confirmations, one fallback demo per partner, and a compact swag plan (thinking virtual swag pins + 2k physical pocket cards).

maria: Sounds good. I'll ping partners about speaker slots. Can we standardize demo envs? some partners want to run on their infra.

ajay: For demos, recommend a tiny dockerized sample or a hosted sandbox link. If partners bring infra, need a fallback on our hosted instance.

sophie: +1 on fallback. Marketing wants a co-branded landing page and a short gif for socials. also: can we ship a digital pin (animated sticker) and offer optional physical enamel pins for VIPs? :sparkles:

kevin: I can mock the animated sticker. For physical pins we should limit to 250 VIPs to keep shipping sane.

maria: partners_ops — any constraints on custom assets for marketplace partners? some want logos and legal approved taglines.

partners_ops: FYI legal needs 3 business days for logo approvals. Also marketplace partners must sign the joint webinar addendum (I’ll share the doc).

maria: timeline: speaker confirmations by Fri (72h), demo specs by next Wed, logos & copy by next Thu, swag RSVP list 10 days before event. ok?

ajay: Technical note: demos that use Redwood Dedicated require a short access token and an IP allowlist. I'll prepare a sandbox token script:
``
# demo token provisioning (one-time)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/demo-token \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \ 
  -d '{"expires_in":3600, "allowlist": ["198.51.100.0/24"]}'
```

kevin: mockups ETA Tue. Sophie — need copy length (headline + 2 bullets?) for landing page.

sophie: Yes — headline + 2 bullets + 1 sentence speaker bio. Keep it punchy for socials.

maria: Speakers I have so far: CloudCo PM (confirmed), NimbusLead (tentative), IntegrateInc Solutions Architect (confirmed). Need a C-level from one partner for the panel or a Redwood exec to fill.

taylor: I'll take the exec slot if partners don't lock a C-level. Also want an ask: each partner shows 1 metric (latency, cost, or reliability) from their integration. Helps the narrative.

partners_ops: Logistics checklist I'm tracking:
- Contracts signed
- Logo + bio approved
- Demo runbook uploaded to shared drive
- Fallback hosted image + access
- Swag delivery list (VIP + general)
- Marketing assets scheduled

kevin: For the live-demo switcher, can we keep a single slack channel for in-run comms and a quick-call number? last time audio delays killed a demo.

ajay: Agreed. Also we should pre-record a 5-min cold demo as ultimate fallback (uploaded to the landing page). I'll record one and drop link.

partners_ops: Swag plan: digital animated pin (everyone), limited physical enamel pins for 250 VIPs, and 1k co-branded pocket cards with QR linking to partner trials. Shipping lead 14 days.

sophie: I'll draft the landing page and social copy by Wed EOD. Need partner logos + alt text by Tue noon to A/B test creative.

maria: I'll chase the two tentatives. If no C-level by EOD Wednesday, taylor takes panel.

deploy-bot: Note: shared drive folder created at https://drive.redwood.ai/partnerships/roundtable-1719994321 (auto).

taylor: Nice — thanks team. Action items: Maria -> speaker confirmations; Ajay -> demo token & pre-record; Kevin -> assets + animated pin; Sophie -> landing + social; Partners_ops -> contracts + swag checklist. I'll run a final tech rehearsal 48 hours before. :thumbsup:
